signInFooter: Only the owner can add users. Your data stays encrypted on this server.
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase of several words works well.
timezoneHint: Transaction dates and monthly import periods follow this timezone.
setupFooter: After this step, nobody can register. As the owner, you add other users in Settings.
servicesIntro: Each service is optional, and you can change these later in Settings. Accounts and manual transactions work without any of them.
ownerIntro: Create the owner account first. Everything is stored encrypted on this server.
chooseOwnPasswordHint: You signed in with a temporary password from the owner. Replace it with one only you know.
chooseOwnPasswordFooter: Your other sessions are signed out once the password changes.
